instruction: Solve the first four modes of a 420x12x10 mm Steel cantilever with density 7.80e-9 tonne/mm3 and 12 mm C3D8R mesh.
init: none; config uploads no files and launches Abaqus/CAE 2025LE
failure_reason: Current GT passes artifact, Frequency step with 4 eigenvalues, Steel elastic/density data, solid section, 420x12x10 geometry, C3D8R/12 mm mesh, and set checks, then fails the Initial-step fixed BC direct-attribute signature. Real-CAE keyword inspection confirms the fixed set has explicit U1/U2/U3 constraints. Independent ODB inspection confirms five frames (base state plus four modes), with first frequency 4.9532 cycles/time. The reopened DisplacementBC exposes no createStepName/u1/u2/u3 direct attributes, so eval exits before its ODB completion check despite valid model and results.

real_software_generation.method: Opened the exact staged Job-Modal-A.cae in the GUI, inspected its fixed BC and synchronized native Boundary block, then opened the exact ODB through Abaqus to verify all four mode frames and frequencies. No replacement was written because content and solver output are valid while direct BC introspection blocks eval.

cleanup: Closed Abaqus without saving keyword synchronization state; removed staged Job-Modal-A/eval outputs and Task 13 inspection files; verified Desktop, task-specific Documents files, and Abaqus windows empty.
